title: Analytic: Mie resonance and Q of a silicon sphere in D2O (spherical multipoles, eigenfrequency)
description:
The sphere of em/fdfd_mie_sphere_resonance_3d and em/fem_mie_sphere_resonance_3d (silicon n = 3.47, r = 200 nm, in D2O n = 1.32) solved by em_fdfd_sphere on a spherical (r, theta) domain over theta = 0 .. pi (the meridional half disc): from the centre to 250 nm in 1 nm radial cells (200 inside the sphere, its surface on a cell edge), 90 theta cells that only draw the picture, D2O in the last 50 nm and, through the outer end 'radiation', continued to infinity (the exact outgoing wave: no PML, no PML modes, nothing to choose). The eigenfrequency study searches the magnetic-dipole term alone (multipole_order 1, multipole_family hr: radial H, Mie b_1, the TE_1 mode of the 3D examples) near its wavelength setting: shift-invert about the target, then the resonance refined with the exact radiation condition at its own complex frequency, so Q carries no PML or target error. Runs in well under a second on the cpu backend (the 3D models: ~65k unknowns and a GPU).
Analytic (Mie, as in the 3D examples): the TE_1 pole x = n_d2o k0 r = 1.11614 - 0.09098 i (exp(-i omega t)), lambda_mie = 2 pi n_d2o r / Re x = 1.4862 um, Q_mie = Re x / (2 |Im x|) = 6.134.
Derived values tab: lambda_1 and Q_1 (row 0 of em.resonances) vs the Mie values (the same names as in the 3D examples; the radial solve is second order in the radial cell, ~1e-4 here, against 1-2 % / 15 % tolerances there).
Field tab: the resonance's sphere-RMS |E_t| (the tangential E circling the dipole axis) and |H_r|, |H_t| radial profiles over the half disc, scaled to a peak |E| of 1 V/m. Set multipole_family to both and multipole_orders to 1, 2, 3 for the electric dipole and the quadrupoles as well (more rows, labelled by l and family).

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform radial cell size (200 cells per sphere radius)

parameters.name: pad
parameters.description: D2O between the sphere and the outer end (the exact outgoing condition needs no more)

parameters.name: x_re
parameters.description: Re of the TE_1 Mie pole x = n_d2o k0 r (exp(-i omega t))
